subject: Quick walkthrough for LumenLytics trial — flexible times
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya@lumenlytics.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-04-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick walkthrough for LumenLytics trial — 15 minutes

Hi Maya,

Thanks for signing up for the LumenLytics trial — welcome! I’m Priyom on the SDR team at Redwood Inference. A quick 15-minute walkthrough is the best primer so we can suggest a compact pilot setup that matches your ingest and latency targets.

I popped a couple of short slots on my calendar for you to pick from: https://cal.redwood.com/priyom/15min (or reply with times that work). I’ve attached a calendar stub you can add directly to your calendar if helpful.

If a live sync isn’t ideal, we can also do a short async walk-through: I’ll record a 7–8 minute screen share tailored to your use case and share notes.

Agenda (very light):
- 5 min: what you’re trying to evaluate
- 7 min: quick product demo focused on low-latency inference and cost levers
- 3 min: next steps / MAP (mutual action plan)

Attachments: [attachment: 15min-microslot.ics (calendar)]

Thanks — looking forward to it.

—
Priyom Das
SDR, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Subject: Re: Quick walkthrough for LumenLytics trial — 15 minutes

Sorry — I missed the 9:30 slot. Had an unexpected platform outage that required my attention.

Can we move the short walkthrough to next week? Prefer mornings (PDT). If easier, send the async recording and I’ll follow up with questions.

Thanks,

LumenLytics

Totally understand — sorry you had to deal with that outage.

Two quick options:
1) Live 15-min microslot next week (I can offer Mon/Tue mornings 9:00–11:30 PDT). Pick any slot here: https://cal.redwood.com/priyom/15min
2) Async: I can record a 7–8 minute walkthrough focused on streaming ingest and embedding throughput; I’ll include a short notes doc + suggested config.

If you prefer, I’ll loop in Evelyn (AE) who can tailor the walkthrough to Marco’s ops/architecture concerns as well. Are there any specific systems you want us to touch on (e.g., Snowflake, Kafka, on-prem gateway)?

—
Priyom
